prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object. Check its properties. Perform specific task if successful, or scan area otherwise.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformTask
	END
